githubDescription:
SakuraCord v0.1.7 Beta 7 adds in-place message editing, live Markdown previews in the composer and message editor, and formatted Markdown files and channel topics. It also redesigns several dialogs, animates sidebar mention badges, and fixes a set of layout and full-screen issues.

## Messages and editing

- Added in-place editing: a message's text becomes editable where it sits in the timeline, with Cancel and Save in the row's action bar, and the rest of the row stays in place unless the edit wraps onto more lines.
- Added live Markdown previews to the composer and message editor: headings, quotes, code blocks, spoilers, inline code and links render as they will in the timeline, and the Markdown syntax stays hidden until the caret reaches it.
- Added formatting to channel topics, so links, mentions, emoji, spoilers and live timestamps render in the topic popover, forum Posting Guidelines and the channel's welcome row.
- Fixed group DMs showing "X removed X from the group." when someone left; they now say "X left the group."

## Media and files

- Added formatted previews for Markdown files in the viewer, including headings, lists, task lists, quotes, code blocks and tables.
- Fixed images saved from link embeds, such as tweets, being saved without a file extension.
- Fixed the full-screen toolbar covering the media viewer's sender details and buttons.

## Dialogs and appearance

- Changed focus rings, text selections and other accents drawn by macOS to use the theme accent instead of the macOS accent colour.
- Redesigned the Forward picker and the attachment editor as Liquid Glass panels, and indented forwarded messages so their bar no longer touches the avatar.
- Removed the separate crop screen when choosing a group DM icon or profile widget image; images now get a centred crop automatically.
- Fixed customization question cards on Channels & Roles sometimes turning into ovals.
- Fixed clicks on the padding of the issue report form and app-command text fields not focusing the field.

## Sidebars and navigation

- Added animations to mention badges in the server rail, server folders, channel list and DM list.
- Changed the right sidebar to remember whether it is open separately for servers, DMs and group DMs.
- Changed voice channels to show only Open Chat in the toolbar, without Inbox and Pinned Messages.
- Improved forum gallery cards so they glide to their new columns when a resize changes the number of columns.

## Performance and reliability

- Improved responsiveness when unread and mention counts change often, and made the server rail smoother under the pointer.
- Fixed the emoji button showing blank in the composer and message actions on macOS 27.3.
- Fixed the PR badge in Settings › Updates › Pull Request Builds floating out of its panel while scrolling.
- Fixed a DM call's area and title staying visible after everyone had left the call.

**Full Changelog:** [v0.1.7-Beta-6...v0.1.7-Beta-7](https://github.com/SakuraCordApp/SakuraCord/compare/v0.1.7-Beta-6...v0.1.7-Beta-7)
discordAnnouncement:
**In-place editing and live Markdown previews 🌙**

**Highlights**
- Edit a message right where it sits in the chat, without the rest of the message jumping around
- Markdown previews as you type in the composer and while editing, styled like the chat, with the syntax hidden until your cursor reaches it
- Markdown files open as formatted documents, and channel topics now show their formatting, mentions and timestamps
- The Forward picker and attachment editor get a Liquid Glass redesign
- Mention badges animate in the sidebar, and servers, DMs and group DMs each remember their own right sidebar
- Fixes for group DM leave messages, saved embed images, full-screen media and the blank emoji button on macOS 27.3
